messages.content:
You are a senior promo editor for vertical microdrama apps (ReelShort, DramaBox, Kuku TV).
You cut 20-60 second promos taken from the show itself. They are posted on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts to pull in NEW viewers who have never seen the show.

A promo that performs:
1. HOOK in the first 3 seconds. The very first thing seen or heard must stop a scrolling thumb: a slap, a shocking or humiliating line, a threat, a reveal, a betrayal, a kiss, a weapon, a collapse. Start ON the action or the line. Never start on an establishing shot, a calm walk, a greeting or small talk. Starting mid-scene is fine if the first line grips instantly.
2. STANDS ALONE. A stranger can tell within seconds who is the underdog, who is the threat and what is at stake, from what is said and shown INSIDE the clip. Avoid moments that only make sense with names, backstory or earlier events the clip does not show.
3. CLIFFHANGER at the cut. End on the most unresolved instant: the threat before it lands, the reveal before the reaction, the question before the answer, the hand raised before the slap. Never end after the conflict resolves, on an explanation, or on a calm line.
4. ESCALATES. Tension should rise from the hook to the cut.

Continuous clips are preferred. You MAY join up to 3 moments (segments) from this episode, in story order, when it gives a clearly stronger promo (for example a hook from one scene and the cliffhanger from a later one).

Hard rules (checked by code; violations are rejected):
- Choose boundaries ONLY by line IDs. A segment runs from the START time of start_line to the END time of end_line.
- Total duration of all segments must be between 20 and 60 seconds; aim for 30-50.
- hook_line must START within the first 3 seconds of the promo (normally it is the first spoken or action line).
- cliffhanger_line must be inside the promo, at or very near its end.
- hook_quote and cliffhanger_quote must be copied exactly from the cited line (or be "" if that moment is purely visual).
Return JSON only.

SHOW: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke
EPISODE 9 of 50 (script duration 115.5 s)

STORY SO FAR (for your understanding only; a new viewer will NOT know this):
E1: Lady Juliana arrives at the cathedral in her late mother's bridal gown, only to suffer the ultimate betrayal when her fiancé Gerald abandons her at the altar for her cruel sister Clarissa with her family's full blessing.
E2: Publicly cast aside at the altar by Gerald for her sister Clarissa and abandoned by her own family, Juliana stands tall and turns her public humiliation into an unyielding indictment of Gerald's honor.
E3: Banished from her mother's chapel and seized by guards at her family's command, Juliana is rescued by an imposing, scarred stranger who intervenes with lethal grace—and drops to one knee with a proposal that shocks high society.
E4: Defying Gerald and Clarissa's cruel mockery, Juliana accepts the mysterious scarred warrior's solemn proposal and is officially wed, choosing exile and dignity over her family's cruelty as they walk out into the light together.
E5: Formally disowned and stripped of her inheritance, Juliana is publicly humiliated when her stepmother throws her late mother's treasured ledger into the mud, but her rugged new husband defends her dignity and guides her away from her callous family.
E6: Seeking shelter from the cold rain, Juliana arrives at her new husband's modest woodland cottage and discovers an unexpected sense of peace beside the hearth.
E7: When Gerald and his spiteful companion arrive at the woodland cottage to mock Juliana's fallen status, her stoic new husband returns from the forest to silently send them fleeing.
E8: As Juliana inspects her late mother's weathered herbal grimoire, Alexander bonds with her over rustic medicinal knowledge and war-worn memories, gently altering her perception of what true wealth means.
Direct lead-in to E9: Picks up immediately after Episode 8, continuing the peaceful evening inside the cottage before an urgent knock shatters the calm.

THIS EPISODE'S LOGLINE: When a frantic mother brings her critically ill child to the woodland cottage, Juliana successfully cures him with her mother's herbal remedies, unknowingly igniting dangerous rumors that reach the ears of the Blond Nobleman.

TIMED SCRIPT. Each line is [ID start-end seconds]. SCREEN/ACTION lines describe what is visible.
[L001 0.0-2.8] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana at the wooden table by candlelight, grinding dried herbs with a pestle inside a stone mortar.
[L002 0.0-2.8] ACTION: Juliana methodically crushes herbs in the mortar beside her open herbal grimoire.
[L003 2.0-3.5] SFX: Heavy, frantic pounding echoes against the heavy wooden cottage door.
[L004 2.8-4.0] ACTION: Juliana stops grinding and lifts her head sharply toward the entrance in alarm.
[L005 3.5-5.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Alexander turning toward the doorway, his eyes sharp and vigilant.
[L006 3.6-5.0] ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Protective): "Stay back. I'll open it."
[L007 4.8-6.6] ACTION: Alexander steps forward and unlatches the cottage door, opening it into the pouring rain.
[L008 5.5-11.2] SCREEN: Medium shot framing the doorway as a soaked, distraught peasant mother steps across the threshold clutching a swaddled child.
[L009 6.3-11.1] PEASANT MOTHER (Frantic, Weeping): "Please! They told me there was a woman here who knows herbs. My boy is burning with fever!"
[L010 11.2-13.5] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana rushing to the front of the table, extending her arms urgently.
[L011 11.4-13.3] JULIANA (Urgent, Compassionate): "Bring him here. Quickly."
[L012 12.0-14.2] ACTION: The trembling mother gently lays the feverish boy down atop the wooden table as Juliana leans in close.
[L013 13.8-15.2] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana gently placing her fingers against the boy's burning forehead.
[L014 15.2-17.8] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana examining the boy's breathing, looking up toward the frantic mother.
[L015 15.5-19.8] JULIANA (Reassuring, Focused): "He seems very unwell, but he is resting steadily. How long has he been like this?"
[L016 17.8-20.0] SCREEN: Medium two-shot of Alexander watching anxiously over the child's shoulder as Juliana tends to him.
[L017 20.0-24.0] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the peasant mother clutching her shawl, tears running down her cheeks.
[L018 20.5-23.9] PEASANT MOTHER (Trembling, Anxious): "Since yesterday morning. He has barely eaten since sunset."
[L019 24.0-27.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana resting two fingers against the boy's wrist, measuring his shallow pulse.
[L020 27.2-28.8] ACTION: Juliana lifts the weathered herbal book and rapidly browses the handwritten pages.
[L021 28.8-31.0] SCREEN: Insert close-up of the open page illustrated with botanical drawings labeled 'Feverfew'.
[L022 29.0-30.8] JULIANA (Muttering, Intent): "Feverfew... Not alone."
[L023 31.0-34.0] SCREEN: Profile close-up of Juliana studying the grimoire's remedies intently while the mother weeps in the soft background.
[L024 31.8-33.8] JULIANA (Determined): "Chamomile... and willow bark."
[L025 34.0-36.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Alexander leaning over the table, gazing at her with intense concern.
[L026 34.9-35.8] ALEXANDER (Grave): "You're certain?"
[L027 36.0-38.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes with resolute conviction.
[L028 36.3-37.4] JULIANA (Resolute): "I have to be."
[L029 38.0-39.8] ACTION: Juliana quickly grabs bundles of dried herbs from the table and turns to Alexander.
[L030 38.2-39.8] JULIANA (Urgent): "Alexander, I need hot water."
[L031 39.9-40.8] ALEXANDER (Prompt): "I'm on it."
[L032 40.8-42.5] ACTION: Alexander hurries to the hearth and lifts a boiling iron kettle from the hearth chain, while the mother buries her face in her hands.
[L033 41.0-42.5] PEASANT MOTHER (Sobbing): "Please save him."
[L034 42.2-43.5] ACTION: Alexander returns and pours steaming hot water into the stone mortar as Juliana prepares the remedy.
[L035 43.0-46.0] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana clasping the mother's trembling hand across the wooden table.
[L036 43.8-45.6] JULIANA (Gentle, Steadfast): "He is not beyond saving."
[L037 46.0-48.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana carefully administering the herbal brew with a small wooden spoon into the sick boy's mouth.
[L038 47.0-48.2] ACTION: The child swallows weakly and lets out a soft cough.
[L039 48.0-50.5] SCREEN: Close-up of the mother clutching her chest in anxious suspense.
[L040 50.5-52.5] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana sitting quietly beside the boy, holding two fingers over his wrist to monitor his pulse.
[L041 52.5-54.0] SCREEN: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the mother leaning across the table in panic.
[L042 52.5-54.0] PEASANT MOTHER (Despairing): "Why isn't it working?"
[L043 54.0-56.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana raising a calm finger, urging patience.
[L044 54.3-55.2] JULIANA (Quiet, Focused): "Wait."
[L045 56.0-58.5] SCREEN: Close-up of the sleeping boy as beads of sweat form on his forehead, his breathing deepening.
[L046 58.5-62.0] SCREEN: Close-up of the mother gently caressing her son's cheek, sobbing with relief.
[L047 58.8-61.8] PEASANT MOTHER (Overcome with Emotion): "His fever... it's breaking."
[L048 62.0-64.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana exhaling a deep breath of relief, smiling gently.
[L049 64.0-65.6] SCREEN: Close-up of the mother looking up at Juliana with overwhelming gratitude.
[L050 64.2-65.5] PEASANT MOTHER (Tearful, Grateful): "You saved him."
[L051 65.6-68.5] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana grasping the mother's hand with warm modesty.
[L052 65.8-68.2] JULIANA (Soft, Gracious): "The herbs did their work. Let him rest."
[L053 68.0-70.5] ACTION: Juliana places a comforting hand over the mother's hands.
[L054 70.5-73.0] ACTION: The mother gathers her sleeping son in her arms and steps back toward the rainy doorway.
[L055 71.0-74.8] SCREEN: Medium shot from inside the cottage framing the mother standing at the open door looking back.
[L056 71.2-74.8] PEASANT MOTHER (Reverent, Vowing): "I will tell the village what you did. They will never forget you."
[L057 74.5-75.5] ACTION: The mother exits into the rainy twilight as Alexander pushes the door shut.
[L058 74.8-77.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Alexander turning from the door, his expression deeply troubled.
[L059 75.1-77.5] ALEXANDER (Stern, Warning): "You cannot let the whole village start talking about you."
[L060 77.5-79.5] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana placing the mortar back onto the table, unflinching.
[L061 77.6-79.4] JULIANA (Defiant, Principled): "A child's life matters more than gossip."
[L062 79.5-81.7] SCREEN: Close-up of Alexander, his jaw clenched with protective anxiety.
[L063 79.6-81.6] ALEXANDER (Dark, Cautionary): "Gossip has a way of becoming dangerous."
[L064 81.7-83.8] SCREEN: Medium two-shot profile of Juliana stepping directly in front of Alexander, looking steadfastly up into his eyes.
[L065 82.0-83.8] JULIANA (Committed, Unshakable): "Then we will face it together."
[L066 83.8-86.5] SCREEN: Wide shot of an opulent gothic manor study. The Blond Nobleman sits in a velvet armchair beside a roaring fireplace, reading an open leather-bound book.
[L067 84.0-86.5] ACTION: The Former Groom, soaked from the rain and clutching his hat, walks nervously through the double doors into the study.
[L068 86.5-88.0] SCREEN: Medium shot framing the Blond Nobleman in the foreground as The Former Groom halts respectfully behind his chair.
[L069 86.6-87.4] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Aloof, Without Looking Up): "What is it?"
[L070 88.0-90.2] SCREEN: Medium close-up of The Former Groom, damp dark hair plastered to his forehead.
[L071 88.0-90.3] THE FORMER GROOM (Hesitant, Deferential): "There is a rumor going around, my Lord."
[L072 90.2-92.0] SCREEN: Close-up of the Blond Nobleman lowering his book, gazing across with mild annoyance.
[L073 90.6-91.4] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Coldly Curious): "What rumor?"
[L074 92.0-95.0] SCREEN: Close-up of The Former Groom speaking cautiously.
[L075 92.1-95.1] THE FORMER GROOM (Uneasy): "About a war veteran. Some say he resembles the late Duke."
[L076 95.0-97.2] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the Blond Nobleman scoffing dismissively as he closes the book.
[L077 95.3-97.3] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Mocking, Arrogant): "People see ghosts whenever they want a story."
[L078 97.2-101.0] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of The Former Groom's eyes widening with urgent dread.
[L079 97.5-101.2] THE FORMER GROOM (Tense, Solemn): "The man is said to have the same kind of scar the Duke carried after the war."
[L080 101.0-102.2] SCREEN: Close-up of the Blond Nobleman snapping his head around, his smug expression freezing into sudden alarm.
[L081 101.4-101.9] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Sharp, Demanding): "Where?"
[L082 102.2-104.0] SCREEN: Medium close-up of The Former Groom shifting uncomfortably.
[L083 102.3-103.6] THE FORMER GROOM (Cautious): "No one seems certain."
[L084 104.0-106.0] SCREEN: Close-up of the Blond Nobleman composing his features into cold disdain, though tension trembles beneath his tone.
[L085 104.2-105.9] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Dismissive, Masking Panic): "Then let it remain a rumor."
[L086 106.0-108.0] SCREEN: Medium shot as The Former Groom turns and retreats silently out of the study, leaving the doors closed.
[L087 108.0-112.0] SCREEN: Side profile shot of the Blond Nobleman seated alone before the roaring fire, staring blankly into the flames in creeping paranoia.
[L088 109.8-111.2] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Whispering, Shaken): "Impossible."
[L089 112.0-115.5] SCREEN: Extreme close-up macro shot of the Blond Nobleman's eye, the flickering fireplace flames dancing across his widening iris as dark dread paralyzes him, holding until the screen cuts to black.

Task: find the best promo candidates in THIS episode. Return 1 to 3 candidates, best first. Fewer is fine when the episode has only one strong moment; never return two candidates that are nearly the same cut.

Return this JSON object:
{
  "episode_summary": "<= 45 words: what happens in this episode, with character names and roles, for story memory",
  "candidates": [
    {
      "title": "3-6 word editor label",
      "segments": [{"start_line": "L0xx", "end_line": "L0yy"}],
      "hook_line": "L0xx",
      "hook": "what the viewer sees/hears in the first 3 seconds and why it stops the scroll",
      "hook_quote": "exact words from hook_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "cliffhanger_line": "L0yy",
      "cliffhanger": "the unresolved question the viewer is left with at the cut",
      "cliffhanger_quote": "exact words from cliffhanger_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "why_it_works": "one sentence",
      "setup_needed": "what a brand-new viewer must already know to follow it, or \"none\"",
      "spoiler_risk": "low | medium | high (does it give away a major twist of the series?)",
      "self_score": 1-10
    }
  ]
}
